Kevin Trudeau says the reason money feels so hard for some families and so easy for others isn't just habits - it's inherited.

He says research now backs up what he learned decades ago in the Brotherhood: trauma and issues from your relatives live on in your DNA. Shy parents tend to raise shy kids. A lineage of divorce tends to repeat. The same, he says, is true for money - wealthy families simply don't carry the block.

If that's true, the problem was never just you.
